questions.stem:
—_____ you ever _____ to the Shenzhen Museum?
—Yes, I went there last month.
questions.explanation: 【解析】问句中有ever（曾经），是"现在完成时"的标志词，询问是否"曾经去过某地"（have been to），强调经历；答句用一般过去时（went）说明具体去的时间。A选项Did go是一般过去时的疑问句式，但缺少ever搭配时的时态呼应；C是一般现在时，不符合语境；D选项have gone to表示"去了某地（还没回来）"，与答句"上个月去过"矛盾。【技巧】ever/never/already/yet常作现完标志；have been to表"去过已回"，have gone to表"去了未回"。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The boy _____ won the first prize in the English speech contest is my classmate.
questions.explanation: 【解析】定语从句先行词是the boy（指人），从句部分_____ won the first prize缺少主语，因此用主格who。B选项which用于指物；C选项whom是who的宾格，在从句中作宾语时使用；D选项whose表示"谁的"，在从句中作定语，后需接名词。本句从句缺主语，故选A。【技巧】定从关系词选择：指人用who/whom/that，指物用which/that；从句缺主语用who/which，缺宾语用whom/which/who（口语），缺定语用whose。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: Many trees _____ in our school every year to make the air cleaner.
questions.explanation: 【解析】主语Many trees（树）与动词plant（种植）是被动关系（树被种），且时间状语every year表示经常性动作，因此用一般现在时的被动语态am/is/are + done。trees是复数，用are planted。A是主动语态原形；C是过去式或过去分词，缺少助动词；D是一般过去时的被动，与every year时间状语不符。【技巧】被动语态结构：be + 过去分词；注意时间状语决定时态，every year/usually/often用一般现在时被动。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Why don't you go to the concert with us?
—I _____ it twice. It's boring.
questions.explanation: 【解析】答句中twice（两次）表示动作发生的次数，强调"过去的经历对现在的影响"（已经看过了，所以觉得无聊不想去），用现在完成时have seen。A选项saw只强调过去某个时间看了，与现在的联系不紧密；C是一般现在时，表示习惯；D是过去完成时，需要出现过去的时间参照点（"过去的过去"），本题没有。【技巧】现在完成时常用标志词：already, yet, ever, never, since, for, 次数（once/twice/three times）。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The sign says "No smoking". It means you cannot _____ here.
questions.explanation: 【解析】根据上下文线索，前句明确提到"No smoking"（禁止吸烟的标志），因此这意味着不能在此smoke（吸烟）。A游泳、C停车、D喊叫均与标志内容无关。【技巧】词义猜测题要利用上下文中的同义、近义或解释性线索，本题属于直接对应。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We should _____ our old clothes to charity instead of throwing them away.
questions.explanation: 【解析】give away表示"捐赠、赠送"；give up表示"放弃"；give in表示"屈服、让步"；give out表示"分发、耗尽"。根据语境"把旧衣服给慈善机构"，应选择"捐赠"之意。【技巧】give短语辨析：away（离开→送走→捐赠），up（向上→停手→放弃），in（进来→让步→屈服），out（出去→分发/耗尽）。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: It is _____ to cross the street when the traffic light is red. (danger)
questions.explanation: 【解析】句型It is + adj. + to do sth.表示"做某事是……的"，此处需要形容词作表语。danger是名词，dangerous是形容词（危险的），dangerously是副词，endanger是动词（危及）。因此选B。【技巧】-ous是常见形容词后缀（dangerous, famous, nervous），-ly是副词后缀。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 【解析】主语millions of tons of plastic waste（塑料垃圾）与动词throw（扔）是被动关系（垃圾被扔），且时间状语every year表示一般现在时，因此用一般现在时被动语态are thrown。B是主动语态；C是过去式，时态和语态都不对；D是过去进行时。【技巧】完形填空先判断主被动关系，再根据时间状语确定时态。

questions.group_passage:
Plastic pollution is one of the biggest environmental problems we face today. Every year, millions of tons of plastic waste (8)_____ into the ocean. This causes serious harm to sea animals. Many of them mistake plastic bags (9)_____ food and eat them by mistake.

To solve this problem, many countries have taken action. For example, some cities have banned (禁止) single-use plastic bags in supermarkets. Shoppers are encouraged to bring their own reusable bags (10)_____. However, this is only a small step. We also need to improve our waste recycling systems.

Education plays an important role too. Schools should teach students about the importance of protecting the environment. When young people understand how their daily habits affect the planet, they will be (11)_____ to make better choices. It is reported that teenagers who learn about environmental protection at school are more likely to (12)_____ waste properly in their daily lives.

The fight against plastic pollution is long, but if everyone makes an effort, we can create a cleaner world for future generations.

questions.stem: According to the passage, what causes afternoon sleepiness?
options: B. Drop in body temperature and blood flow changes
questions.explanation: 【解析】细节理解题。根据文章第二段"Our body temperature drops slightly after lunch, which makes us feel tired. Also, when we eat a big meal, our blood flow increases to the stomach... This means less blood goes to the brain, causing sleepiness."可知，午后困倦的原因是体温轻微下降和血液流向变化（流向胃部帮助消化，大脑供血减少）。A选项高温与文中体温下降相反；C缺乏蛋白质是第三段提到的不同食物的影响，不是困倦的直接原因；D选项运动未提及。【技巧】细节题要精准定位原文，注意同义转换：blood flow increases to the stomach = blood flow changes。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Do you often feel sleepy after lunch? Many people experience this "afternoon slump" (午后萎靡). But why does it happen?

Scientists have found that it has something to do with our biological clock (生物钟). Our body temperature drops slightly after lunch, which makes us feel tired. Also, when we eat a big meal, our blood flow increases to the stomach to help digestion (消化). This means less blood goes to the brain, causing sleepiness.

However, not all foods have the same effect. Meals high in carbohydrates (碳水化合物), such as rice and noodles, can make you feel sleepier than protein-rich foods (富含蛋白质的食物). This is because carbohydrates help produce a chemical called serotonin (血清素) in the brain, which makes us feel relaxed and sleepy.

So how can we beat the afternoon slump? First, try to have a lighter lunch with more vegetables and protein. Second, taking a short walk after eating can help increase blood flow to the brain. Finally, a 10-minute power nap (小睡) in the afternoon can actually improve your focus and productivity for the rest of the day.

Remember, feeling sleepy after lunch is completely normal. By understanding the science behind it and making small changes to your habits, you can stay alert and energetic throughout the afternoon.

options: A. It is produced in the stomach
B. It makes people feel excited

questions.explanation: 【解析】推理判断题。根据第三段"This is because carbohydrates help produce a chemical called serotonin (血清素) in the brain, which makes us feel relaxed and sleepy."可推断出血清素是由碳水化合物帮助产生的，并且会导致困倦（使人放松和 sleepy）。A选项错误，是在大脑中产生而非胃部；B选项与原文sleepy相反；D选项文中未提及有害。【技巧】推理题要基于原文信息进行逻辑推导，不能过度推断，注意which引导的定语从句修饰serotonin。

questions.explanation: 【解析】选句子填空。本段主题是"参加课外活动"，空格前说"参加社团或运动队能帮助培养团队合作技能并结交新朋友"，空格后说"平衡是快乐成功学校生活的关键"，因此此处需要补充说明课外活动的另一个好处，C选项"此外，它使学校生活更加丰富多彩和愉快"符合In addition的递进关系，it指代前文的Joining clubs...。A是提问话题；B是例子；D是总起；E虽然涉及平衡，但On the other hand通常表对比而非递进，且studying all the time与前文joining clubs不直接对应。【技巧】In addition/Furthermore/Moreover用于补充同类优点或信息。

Middle school is an important time in our lives. We not only learn knowledge but also develop habits that will stay with us forever. (17)_____ Here are some tips to help you make the most of your school days.

First, manage your time wisely. Make a study schedule and stick to it. (18)_____ This will help you avoid staying up late before exams.

Second, don't be afraid to ask questions. Many students feel shy about raising their hands in class. (19)_____ Remember, there is no such thing as a stupid question. Teachers appreciate curious students.

Finally, take part in extracurricular activities. Joining clubs or sports teams can help you develop teamwork skills and make new friends. (20)_____ Balance is the key to a happy and successful school life.
